answer: Locks are written down in vine, expire in relic, and onyx lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 125 aliases therefore needs 80 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4502 identities would post 4580 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
